shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白的作业许可证，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank work permit form with a pen clipped on it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天考考你：作业许可三十问！
overlay: 作业许可三十问：签发人与接收人

shots.scene: 一排图标：许可证、两个握手的人、放大镜、火焰、盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A row of simple icons: a blank permit form, two hands shaking, a magnifier, a flame and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 谁签发，谁接收，怎么检查，怎么监护。

shots.scene: 老李扛着工具箱来到实验室门口，抬头看天花板上的风管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer arrives at a laboratory door carrying a toolbox and looks up at the ventilation duct on the ceiling.
shots.narration: 实验楼的排风管要检修，老李来了。

shots.scene: 阿杰热情地招手：直接进来修吧
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waves the facility engineer in eagerly, pointing at the ceiling duct.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：直接进来修吧，很快的。

shots.scene: 小研伸手拦住，手里拿着空白的许可证
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises a hand to pause them and holds up a blank permit form.
shots.narration: 小研拦住：先办作业许可，再动手。

shots.scene: 老周和老李面对面，中间是许可证和一支笔
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer stand face to face with a blank permit form and a pen on a small table between them.
shots.narration: 老周是签发人，老李是接收人。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前拿起马克笔
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard holding a marker.
shots.narration: 我们用三十道题，把流程走一遍。

shots.section_title: 测验用法：先选再对答案
shots.scene: 白板上画着 abcd 四个空格和一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with four empty answer boxes in a column and a checkmark beside one of them. No people.
shots.narration: 每道题先自己选，别急着看答案。
overlay: 测验用法：先选再对答案

shots.section_title: 测验用法：先选再对答案
shots.scene: 阿杰在纸上打勾，再对照一张答案卡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student ticks boxes on a blank answer sheet, then compares it with a blank answer card.
shots.narration: 最后对照答案，数数自己答对几题。

shots.section_title: 测验用法：先选再对答案
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 我们每题都讲一句为什么。

shots.section_title: 许可制度为了防止事故
shots.scene: 许可证图标和一个被盾牌挡住的事故图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit icon beside a shield that blocks a broken warning triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：为什么要用作业许可制度？
overlay: 许可制度为了防止事故

shots.section_title: 许可制度为了防止事故
shots.scene: 三张卡片打叉：证书、记录本、钟表
shots.prompt_en: Three icon cards crossed out with red X marks: a certificate, a logbook and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 不是为了换证、记事故或者记工时。

shots.section_title: 许可制度为了防止事故
shots.scene: 欣欣点头，盾牌发光
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods next to a glowing shield icon.
shots.narration: 答案是防止事故，把风险挡在开工前。

shots.scene: 两张空白资格证，旁边是日历
shots.prompt_en: Two blank qualification cards with a calendar icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：签发人、接收人的资格证。
overlay: 资格证有有效期

shots.scene: 日历翻页，资格证变灰，再出现培训教室
shots.prompt_en: A calendar flips pages, a qualification card turns grey, then a small training classroom icon appears. No people.
shots.narration: 资格证有有效期，到期要复训取证。

shots.scene: 王老师翻开空白的制度手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank rules handbook at a desk.
shots.narration: 期限以现行规定和本校制度为准。

shots.scene: 一张资格证和一支笔，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: A blank qualification card and a pen with a question mark beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：资格证由谁签？
overlay: 资格证由主管签发

shots.scene: 王老师在资格证上签字盖章
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank qualification card and stamps it.
shots.narration: 由单位授权的主管签发。

shots.scene: 一个人给自己签字的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person signing his own card is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 本人、工长或代表都不能自己签。

shots.section_title: 许可证列的是最低措施
shots.scene: 许可证上一排勾选框
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a blank permit form with a column of empty checkboxes. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：许可证上列的是什么措施？
overlay: 许可证列的是最低措施

shots.section_title: 许可证列的是最低措施
shots.scene: 勾选框下方画着一条底线
shots.prompt_en: The checkboxes sit above a thick floor line, with an upward arrow above the line. No people.
shots.narration: 列的是必须做到的最低安全措施。

shots.section_title: 许可证列的是最低措施
shots.scene: 老李在许可证上加了一行
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer adds an extra line to a blank permit form with a pen.
shots.narration: 现场需要更多，就要加上去。

shots.section_title: 签发人判定低风险可免证
shots.scene: 限制区门口，一张许可证和一个低风险绿色标记
shots.prompt_en: A door with a restricted area pictogram, a blank permit form and a green low-risk tag beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：限制区里何时可以不办证？
overlay: 签发人判定低风险可免证

shots.section_title: 签发人判定低风险可免证
shots.scene: 老周思考后点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man studies a simple task card, thinks, then nods.
shots.narration: 签发人判定为低风险的作业。

shots.section_title: 签发人判定低风险可免证
shots.scene: 冷作业图标和跳过检查图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A snowflake icon and a skipped-checklist icon, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 光说冷作业或省掉检查，不是理由。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员拿着灭火器站在作业点旁
shots.prompt_en: The security officer stands beside a work spot holding a fire extinguisher, watching carefully.
shots.narration: 第六题：什么时候要派监火人？
overlay: 可能起火就设监火人

shots.scene: 火花、热表面、易燃瓶几个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sparks, a hot surface and a closed flammable bottle with a flame pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 只要可能起火，就要派监火人。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wags a finger gently.
shots.narration: 不只限动火，也不看某个读数。

shots.section_title: 联合检查：签发人和接收人
shots.scene: 老周和老李一起走进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer walk into a laboratory together, side by side.
shots.narration: 第七题：谁去做现场联合检查？
overlay: 联合检查：签发人和接收人

shots.section_title: 联合检查：签发人和接收人
shots.scene: 两人一起看风管和台面
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer look up at the duct and down at the benches together.
shots.narration: 签发人和接收人，一起到现场。

shots.scene: 老周查看老李的资格证
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks the qualification card of the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 第八题：签发前必须做哪两件事？
overlay: 签发前核证并会签

shots.scene: 许可证上两个签名栏都签上
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form with two signature boxes being signed one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 核对接收人资格证，取得会签。

shots.section_title: 为什么要交代现场危害
shots.scene: 老周指着现场的风管和气瓶向老李讲解
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at a duct and a secured gas cylinder while explaining to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 第九题：为什么要交代现场危害？
overlay: 为什么要交代现场危害

shots.section_title: 为什么要交代现场危害
shots.scene: 老李头顶出现问号，身后是陌生的房间
shots.prompt_en: A question mark floats above the facility engineer as he looks around an unfamiliar laboratory.
shots.narration: 因为接收人可能从没在这里干过。

shots.section_title: 为什么要交代现场危害
shots.scene: 老李点头，在本子上记下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer nods and writes notes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 哪里有风险，要当面讲清楚。

shots.section_title: 联合检查关注现场安全
shots.scene: 两人在现场环视，周围浮现盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer look around the work site; a shield icon glows above them.
shots.narration: 第十题：联合检查共同关注什么？
overlay: 联合检查关注现场安全

shots.section_title: 联合检查关注现场安全
shots.scene: 盾牌罩住整个作业区
shots.prompt_en: A large shield outline covers a small laboratory work area. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是作业现场的安全。

shots.section_title: 需要许可的区域叫限制区
shots.scene: 一扇门上贴着限制区图标和许可证图标
shots.prompt_en: A door with a restricted area pictogram and a permit icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：需要办证的区域叫什么？
overlay: 需要许可的区域叫限制区

shots.section_title: 需要许可的区域叫限制区
shots.scene: 四个区域卡片，限制区那张被圈出
shots.prompt_en: Four blank area cards in a row; one with a restricted area pictogram is circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: 叫限制区，进去作业要先办证。

shots.section_title: 许可授权特定的施工维修
shots.scene: 许可证上画着扳手和安全帽图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form with a wrench icon and a hard hat icon on it. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：许可制度还为了什么？
overlay: 许可授权特定的施工维修

shots.section_title: 许可授权特定的施工维修
shots.scene: 考勤钟图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A time clock icon crossed out with a red X next to a blank permit form. No people.
shots.narration: 授权特定的施工维修，不是考勤表。

shots.section_title: 许可覆盖施工维修修理
shots.scene: 三个图标：砖块、扳手、螺丝刀
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a stack of bricks, a wrench and a screwdriver. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：许可授权哪类作业？
overlay: 许可覆盖施工维修修理

shots.section_title: 许可覆盖施工维修修理
shots.scene: 欣欣指着三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at three icons: bricks, a wrench and a screwdriver.
shots.narration: 特定的施工、维修和修理作业。

shots.section_title: 现场安全不是一个人的事
shots.scene: 天平一边站着老周，一边站着老李
shots.prompt_en: A simple balance scale icon with the older man on one side and the facility engineer on the other, level.
shots.narration: 第十四题：现场安全全归签发人？
overlay: 现场安全不是一个人的事

shots.section_title: 现场安全不是一个人的事
shots.scene: 大大的错号
shots.prompt_en: A large red X mark over a single person icon carrying a heavy shield. No people.
shots.narration: 错！签发人和接收人共同负责。

shots.section_title: 现场安全不是一个人的事
shots.scene: 老周、老李、小研三人一起点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the facility engineer and the female graduate student nod together.
shots.narration: 干活的人，也要为安全负责。

shots.scene: 泵、储罐、井口三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a pump, a row of storage tanks and a wellhead. No people.
shots.narration: 第十五题：限制区有哪些地方？
overlay: 限制区举例

shots.scene: 餐厅和宿舍图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A dining table icon and a dormitory icon, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 泵站、罐区、气井；餐厅宿舍不算。

shots.scene: 实验楼里的危化品库和气瓶间门牌
shots.prompt_en: Two laboratory doors: one with a chemical storage pictogram, one with a gas cylinder pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 实验楼里，危化品库和气瓶间也类似。

shots.scene: 老周拿着低风险绿色标签
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds a green tag beside a simple task card.
shots.narration: 第十六题：谁来判定是低风险？
overlay: 谁判定低风险

shots.scene: 接收人自己贴标签的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a worker sticking a tag on his own task is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 签发人判定，接收人不能自己说了算。

shots.scene: 四张卡片：加油站、码头、垃圾场、罐区
shots.prompt_en: Four icon cards: a fuel pump, a pier, a garbage dump and storage tanks. No people.
shots.narration: 第十七题：哪个不属于限制区？
overlay: 哪里不是限制区

shots.scene: 垃圾场卡片被圈出
shots.prompt_en: The garbage dump card is circled; the fuel pump, pier and tank cards carry flame pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 垃圾场不是；其余都有易燃风险。

shots.scene: 老李胸前别着资格证
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a blank qualification badge on his chest and smiles.
shots.narration: 第十八题：谁是许可证接收人？
overlay: 谁是接收人

shots.scene: 随手指派的人和普通工人图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two plain worker icons crossed out with red X marks, beside a worker icon with a badge and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 经过认证、有资格接收许可的人。

shots.scene: 老周站在自己实验室的设备前
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands in front of the equipment and benches of his own laboratory.
shots.narration: 第十九题：签发人负责什么？
overlay: 签发人对属地负责

shots.scene: 签发后撒手不管的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person walking away from a signed form is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 对设备和作业区域负责，签了不撒手。

shots.scene: 一个区域地图，上面有个问号
shots.prompt_en: A simple floor plan with one area marked by a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十题：谁决定划为限制区？
overlay: 谁决定划为限制区

shots.scene: 王老师在地图上画圈
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator draws a circle around one area on a floor plan.
shots.narration: 由上级管理者最终决定。

shots.scene: 空白制度手册
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank rules handbook on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 国内谁定，以本校制度为准。

shots.scene: 扫帚、眼睛、抹布三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a broom, an eye and a cleaning cloth. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十一题：哪些是低风险作业？
overlay: 低风险作业举例

shots.scene: 喷枪、喷砂图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A spray gun icon and an abrasive blasting icon, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 清扫、目视检查、轻微清洁。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with a question mark.
shots.narration: 拿不准时，按需要办证来处理。

shots.scene: 限制区门口，老李递上许可证
shots.prompt_en: At a door with a restricted area pictogram, the facility engineer hands over a blank permit form.
shots.narration: 第二十二题：限制区作业要求什么？
overlay: 限制区作业要办证

shots.scene: 许可证上盖上绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form receives a big green check stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 要求办理作业许可证。

shots.scene: 小研拿着记录板巡视现场
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks around the work site holding a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 第二十三题：指定代表能做什么？
overlay: 指定代表能做什么

shots.scene: 代签、准假、担责三个图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: a pen over a form, a vacation icon and a heavy backpack. No people.
shots.narration: 可以检查现场，不能代签、代担责。

shots.scene: 老李和一排工具，身后有一摞证书
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands with a neat row of tools and a stack of blank certificates behind him.
shots.narration: 第二十四题：接收人该是什么人？
overlay: 接收人要有资格经验

shots.scene: 老李在培训课上听讲
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer listens attentively in a small training class.
shots.narration: 有经验的技工，经过培训和授权。

shots.section_title: 接收人遵守措施并签字
shots.scene: 老李在许可证上签字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer signs a blank permit form.
shots.narration: 第二十五题：接收人主要干什么？
overlay: 接收人遵守措施并签字

shots.section_title: 接收人遵守措施并签字
shots.scene: 勾选框逐个打勾
shots.prompt_en: Checkboxes on a blank form get ticked one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 遵守每项安全措施，并签字确认。

shots.section_title: 领证前读懂并同意条件
shots.scene: 老李认真读许可证
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reads a blank permit form carefully, finger following the lines.
shots.narration: 第二十六题：领证前要做哪两件事？
overlay: 领证前读懂并同意条件

shots.section_title: 领证前读懂并同意条件
shots.scene: 老李点头并签字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer nods and signs the blank form.
shots.narration: 读懂许可证，同意全部条件。

shots.section_title: 领证前读懂并同意条件
shots.scene: 看都不看就签字的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand signing with closed eyes is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看不懂就问，别闭着眼签字。

shots.section_title: 联合检查讨论范围和设备
shots.scene: 老周和老李对着风管和工具清单讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer discuss the duct while looking at a blank tool list.
shots.narration: 第二十七题：联合检查讨论什么？
overlay: 联合检查讨论范围和设备

shots.section_title: 联合检查讨论范围和设备
shots.scene: 范围框和工具图标
shots.prompt_en: A dashed boundary box around a duct section with tool icons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 干到哪里为止，用哪些设备。

shots.section_title: 联合检查时确认设备备妥
shots.scene: 老周检查断开的风机开关和挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks a switched-off fan control with a blank hanging tag during a site walk.
shots.narration: 第二十八题：何时确认设备已备妥？
overlay: 联合检查时确认设备备妥

shots.section_title: 联合检查时确认设备备妥
shots.scene: 时间线上，联合检查那一格亮起
shots.prompt_en: A simple timeline with four steps; the second step with a magnifier icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 在联合检查时，开工前就确认。

shots.section_title: 一起检查为了讲清风险
shots.scene: 老李指着风管提问，老周解答
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at the duct and asks; the older man answers.
shots.narration: 第二十九题：接收人为何一起检查？
overlay: 一起检查为了讲清风险

shots.section_title: 一起检查为了讲清风险
shots.scene: 两人中间浮现警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A yellow warning triangle icon floats between two speech bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 为了当面讨论危害和风险。

shots.section_title: 在用易燃设备动火设监火人
shots.scene: 运行中的管道图标带火焰标志
shots.prompt_en: A pipe icon with a flowing arrow and a flame pictogram beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第三十题：在用易燃设备上动火呢？
overlay: 在用易燃设备动火设监火人

shots.section_title: 在用易燃设备动火设监火人
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员拿灭火器站在一旁
shots.prompt_en: The security officer stands by with a fire extinguisher, eyes on the work spot.
shots.narration: 必须设监火人，专人盯守。

shots.section_title: 在用易燃设备动火设监火人
shots.scene: 王老师翻开空白手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank handbook and points to a page.
shots.narration: 这类动火风险最高，按最严要求审批。

shots.section_title: 测验用法：先选再对答案
shots.scene: 白板上 30 个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard filled with rows of green checkmarks. No people.
shots.narration: 三十题做完了，你答对几题？

shots.section_title: 实验楼施工的属地审批
shots.scene: 实验楼平面图上，实验室、学院、后勤保卫三个图标相连
shots.prompt_en: A building floor plan with three linked icons: a laboratory, a college building and a security shield. No people.
shots.narration: 国内高校：实验楼施工要先报审批。
overlay: 实验楼施工的属地审批

shots.section_title: 实验楼施工的属地审批
shots.scene: 老周在申请表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank application form at his desk.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人对本屋负属地责任。

shots.section_title: 实验楼施工的属地审批
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员审核动火申请
shots.prompt_en: The security officer reviews a blank application form with a flame icon.
shots.narration: 动火要按消防规定事先审批。

shots.section_title: 实验楼施工的属地审批
shots.scene: 王老师合上制度手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator closes a blank rules handbook.
shots.narration: 流程以现行法规和本校制度为准。

shots.scene: 小研把试剂瓶装箱搬走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student packs closed reagent bottles into a box and carries it away.
shots.narration: 开工前清场：化学品移走或隔离。
overlay: 维修前清场与去污

shots.scene: 气瓶推走，生物样品放进冰箱锁好
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder is moved out on a cart, and sample racks are locked in a refrigerator. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶、生物材料也要妥善处理。

shots.scene: 小研擦拭通风柜台面，贴上空白确认单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes a fume hood surface and sticks a blank confirmation tag on it.
shots.narration: 设备先去污，交给维修方确认。

shots.scene: 阿杰停下手里的实验
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops his experiment and switches off a hot plate.
shots.narration: 相关实验暂停，不边做边修。

shots.section_title: 告知相邻实验室并隔离
shots.scene: 小研在隔壁实验室门口通知同学
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student talks to students at the door of the neighboring laboratory.
shots.narration: 排风停了会影响隔壁，先告知。
overlay: 告知相邻实验室并隔离

shots.section_title: 告知相邻实验室并隔离
shots.scene: 门口拉起警戒带，挂上告示牌
shots.prompt_en: A barrier tape across a lab doorway with a blank notice board and a construction warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 作业区拉警戒、挂告示。

shots.section_title: 告知相邻实验室并隔离
shots.scene: 无关人员图标被挡在警戒带外
shots.prompt_en: Small person icons stop outside a barrier tape line. No people.
shots.narration: 无关人员不进入作业区。

shots.section_title: 维修粉尘噪声与危害告知
shots.scene: 老李戴上防尘口罩和耳罩钻孔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a dust mask, safety goggles and ear muffs while drilling a wall.
shots.narration: 钻孔切割会有粉尘和噪声。
overlay: 维修粉尘噪声与危害告知

shots.section_title: 维修粉尘噪声与危害告知
shots.scene: 墙上贴着职业危害告知卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank occupational hazard notice card with dust and noise pictograms on a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 用人单位要告知危害、发放防护。

shots.section_title: 维修粉尘噪声与危害告知
shots.scene: 防尘口罩、耳塞、护目镜整齐摆放
shots.prompt_en: A dust mask, ear plugs and safety goggles laid out neatly on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 防护用品按国家标准选，会正确戴。

shots.scene: 老李在昏暗的吊顶里眯眼看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer squints at a dim ceiling opening, struggling to see.
shots.narration: 吊顶里光线暗，容易看错。
overlay: 检修照明与视觉疲劳

shots.scene: 老李打开头灯和工作灯，四周明亮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns on a headlamp and a portable work light; the area becomes bright.
shots.narration: 带足照明，看清再动手。

shots.scene: 老李放下工具，眨眨眼远眺窗外
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts down his tools, blinks and looks out a window into the distance.
shots.narration: 久盯细处会累，定时停下歇眼。

shots.scene: 联合检查时两人用手电照看角落
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer shine a flashlight into a corner during the site check.
shots.narration: 检查时照亮角落，别漏隐患。

shots.scene: 流程图：申请、交底、联合检查、监护、关闭
shots.prompt_en: A simple flow chart of five boxes joined by arrows, each with an icon: form, speech bubble, magnifier, extinguisher, lock. No people.
shots.narration: 申请、交底、检查、监护、关闭。

shots.scene: 老周和老李握手
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer shake hands over a signed blank permit form.
shots.narration: 签发人和接收人，共同负责。

shots.scene: 小研检查清空的台面和警戒带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a cleared bench and a barrier tape at the door.
shots.narration: 清场、告知、照明，样样到位。

shots.scene: 老李完工后，老周验收并恢复排风
shots.prompt_en: After the work, the older man inspects the duct and switches the fan back on while the facility engineer packs up.
shots.narration: 完工验收，确认安全再恢复实验。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别，身旁是签好的许可证
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a signed blank permit form on a stand.
shots.narration: 先办许可再动手，安全才放心！
